# FDG9017

> CONSIDER exposing access to internal factored types of an aggregate component.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

Not machine-checkable: which factored types an aggregate component should expose (the SerialPort example) is a design judgment.

## From the book

Factored types are ideal for integrating different feature areas. For example, the `SerialPort` component exposes access to its stream, thus allowing integration with reusable APIs, such as compression APIs that operate on streams.
